payload.hypothesis: VC6 does not lay same-name virtual overload groups out in declaration order: measured on MidiDelegate, both pairs (set_active_tracks, map_patch) compile with the higher-arity member first regardless of declaration order, so sharing Midi's forwarder names across each delegate pair placed every dispatch on the wrong slot (0x90<->0x94 and 0xd8<->0xdc swapped, each body exactly one constant off). The uniform rule fitting all measured pairs including the image's Sound pairs (play, fade, fade_in - where play and fade_in are declared in image order and byte-measured, falsifying plain declaration reversal) is descending parameter count. Fix applied 2026-09-18: the two higher-arity delegate slots (0x94, 0xdc) took neutral slotNNN names (slot037, slot055), which pin each slot by position under any group ordering and claim nothing about the wrapped class's unevidenced member names - the header's established slotNNN convention; the two Midi forwarder bodies call the renamed members. Final check: all four bodies pass, 36 pass / 2 fail / 4 unknown on the task, no regressions.
